replies.text:
Each fish has its own tiny steering agent, with two slow sine waves impacting them the most. I put a cap on their turn rate so it's more organic.

Its head leaves a trail of positions and we walk along that to place its 10 spine segments so the body follows the same path. The shader receives these points and builds the body, then applies the dither overtop 👌
